description: This Java class 'UtilPlist' provides utility methods for writing property list (plist) files in XML or plain format, including handling nested maps and lists, and generating plist files for Apple EOModelBundle format.

classes.name: UtilPlist
classes.description: Final utility class for writing plist files, supporting both XML and plain formats, with methods for nested data structures and Apple EOModelBundle format.

methods.name: writePlistProperty
methods.description: Writes a property with a given name and value, handling nested maps and lists.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyMap
methods.description: Writes a map of properties in plist format, with optional comma separation.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyValueList
methods.description: Writes a list of property values in plist format.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyXml
methods.description: Writes a property in XML plist format, handling nested structures.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyMapXml
methods.description: Writes a map in XML plist format.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyValueListXml
methods.description: Writes a list in XML plist format.

methods.name: writePlistFile
methods.description: Creates and writes a plist file in either XML or plain format, supporting the Apple EOModelBundle structure.
